name: Spore Matron
prompt: One full-body FRONT orthographic eye-level monster reference, beautiful hand-painted stylized fantasy MMORPG art for Elyndra, warm painterly detailed materials, readable game silhouette. Spore Matron: a tall mushroom with a wide frilled cap, a stalk like a robed figure, jade spore-lanterns hanging under the cap. Elegant eerie fungal matriarch, creamy tan fibrous stalk folds resemble a long robe, broad layered frilled mushroom cap in muted plum and earthy ochre, several attached glowing jade organic lantern pods dangling beneath cap on fungal cords. The body is actual fungus, not a human wearing clothes. Tall tapered stalk with small rootlike base, no weapons, no additional creatures. Straight front body and cap, centered, entire cap and root base visible, ample blank margins. Transparent background, no ground or cast shadow, no labels, no text. Soft painted dimensional shading; restrained glow attached to pods, no floating particle cloud. Single production concept master.
review: Created; visual and alpha audit pending.
